name: Pirin National Park
description: Pirin National Park covers a rugged stretch of the Pirin Mountains in southwest Bulgaria, rising to the 2,914-metre summit of Vihren. Its limestone peaks shelter 118 glacial lakes, as well as waterfalls, caves and dense conifer forests. Visitors can even see Snezhnika, Europe's southernmost glacier, and a pine thought to be 1,300 years old.
